principles: Make G02 an independent executable baseline group, not a comment on G01.
Preserve no-false-DONE boundaries: one missing required row must remain visible and block full completion.
Keep the slice narrow: add one smoke and update only the baseline document.
Separate local synthetic evidence from rollout, Authority, production, or multi-host claims.
drivers: User wants the second group of the 10x15 baseline to continue after G01.
The baseline must become a reliable UDM regression guard against fake DONE claims.
Existing evaluator behavior should be validated, not broadened, for this slice.

options.name: A: standalone G02 missing-row smoke plus doc boundary update
pros: Matches the documented G02 row in the baseline matrix.
cons: Adds one more task-level smoke to maintain.

options.name: B: treat G01 truncated-row guard as G02 coverage
pros: No new code would be needed.
cons: Would falsely count G02 as implemented without a G02 ledger identity.
Does not create a runnable G02 command or documentation boundary.

options.name: C: implement all remaining G02-G10 groups now
pros: Moves the full baseline further in one large slice.
cons: Too broad for this story and increases false-DONE risk.
Would violate the current request to continue the second group only.

chosen: A: standalone G02 missing-row smoke plus doc boundary update
rationale: Choose the standalone G02 smoke because it creates fresh machine evidence for the exact second baseline group while keeping the scope small enough to audit.

preMortem.scenario: G02 is marked implemented by reusing G01 negative guard only.
preMortem.trigger: Reviewer accepts same-code evidence without a G02 ledger identity.
preMortem.consequence: The 10x15 progress table overstates delivered baseline coverage.
preMortem.mitigation: Create a separate G02 smoke file, command, ledger id, row ids, and doc row.

preMortem.scenario: The document claims full 10x15 completion after G02.
preMortem.trigger: Progress wording is broadened from G01-G02 implemented to all groups implemented.
preMortem.consequence: UDM baseline evidence becomes a false DONE example itself.
preMortem.mitigation: Assert and grep that G03-G10 remain future and full 10x15 remains incomplete.

preMortem.scenario: Local synthetic proof is worded as production or Authority readiness.
preMortem.trigger: Doc or smoke claim boundary uses elevated rollout vocabulary.
preMortem.consequence: Users could mistake a local baseline for external conformance or two-host assurance.
preMortem.mitigation: Keep no-elevated-claim assertions in the smoke and run the retired-authority vocabulary guard.
